title: 第10章 一拳轰飞第11章 轰杀
lines: 动作简洁，质朴，如同凡俗武夫演练了千万遍的基础拳式。
然而，就在他拳头递出的刹那——
一声无法用言语形容的恐怖龙吟，骤然炸响！
仿佛沉睡了亿万纪元的洪荒祖龙，睁开了它的眼眸！
昂！
金光！
纯粹到极致、尊贵到极致、霸道到极致的……黄金神光，自叶无缺的拳锋之上轰然爆发！
瞬间淹没了整个战场核心！
那光芒之盛，甚至盖过了祭坛顶端搏动的生命光霞！
在所有人惊骇欲绝的目光中，一条栩栩如生的……黄金大龙！
自那璀璨的金光中咆哮而出！
龙躯横亘虚空，每一片龙鳞都清晰可见，流淌着开天辟地的混沌气息！
龙角峥嵘，刺破苍穹！
龙爪探出，撕裂万道！
那双巨大的龙眸，如同两轮燃烧的黄金太阳，俯瞰苍生，蕴含着至高无上的威严与……纯粹的、凌驾于万灵之上的绝对霸道！
真龙现世！
镇压诸天！
叶无缺这一拳，赫然是……真龙拳！
黄金大龙咆哮着，带着碾碎一切、破灭万法的无上意志，狠狠撞上了君逍遥那霸绝天地的暗金拳罡！
没有僵持！
没有对抗！
只有……摧枯拉朽！
如同烧红的烙铁切入牛油！
那蕴含着君逍遥极霸之体本源伟力、足以镇杀祖神境大圆满的霸天镇世拳罡，在黄金大龙面前，脆弱得不堪一击！
暗金拳罡如同遭遇天敌的冰雪，瞬间消融、崩解！
恐怖的霸纹神焰被龙息一吹，直接熄灭！
那霸绝天地的意志，在真龙那源自血脉源头的至高霸道面前，如同萤火之于皓月，被瞬间碾得粉碎！
黄金大龙去势不减，带着毁灭一切的咆哮，狠狠撞在了君逍遥那绽放着暗金神芒、铭刻着霸纹的……胸膛之上！
无法形容的撞击声中，夹杂着清晰无比的骨裂之音！
君逍遥那完美无瑕的脸上，瞬间失去了所有血色，布满了前所未有的惊骇、茫然与……无法置信！
content_en:
The movements are concise and simple, just like the basic boxing styles practiced by ordinary martial artists thousands of times.
However, the moment he extended his fist——
“Hoo—!
! "
A terrifying dragon roar that could not be described in words suddenly exploded!
It was as if the ancestral dragon that had been sleeping for hundreds of millions of epochs opened its eyes!
hold head high!
Golden light!
Pure to the extreme, noble to the extreme, domineering to the extreme... golden divine light burst out from Ye Wuque's fist!
Instantly flooded the core of the entire battlefield!
The radiance was so great that it even overshadowed the pulsating glow of life at the top of the altar!
In everyone's horrified eyes, a lifelike... golden dragon!
Roaring out from the bright golden light!
The dragon body stretches across the void, and every dragon scale is clearly visible, flowing with the aura of chaos that created the world!
The dragon's horns are majestic and pierce the sky!
The dragon's claws came out and tore apart thousands of ways!
Those huge dragon eyes are like two burning golden suns, overlooking the common people, containing supreme majesty and... pure, absolute domineering over all spirits!
The real dragon appears!
Suppress the heavens!
Ye Wuque's punch was... the True Dragon Fist!
The golden dragon roared, with the supreme will to crush everything and destroy all laws, and slammed into Jun Xiaoyao's dark golden fist that dominated the world!
No stalemate!
No confrontation!
Only...destroying!
laugh--!
Like a red-hot iron cutting into butter!
The Tyrant World-Suppressing Fist, which contains the original power of Jun Xiaoyao's extremely domineering body and is enough to kill the Great Perfection of the Ancestral God Realm, is so fragile in front of the golden dragon!
The Dark Gold Fist Gang melted and disintegrated instantly like ice and snow encountering a natural enemy!
The terrifying Tyrannical Divine Flame was blown out by the dragon's breath and was immediately extinguished!
That will to dominate the world, in front of the supreme domineering power of the true dragon that originated from the source of blood, was like a firefly to the bright moon, and was instantly crushed to pieces!
The golden dragon continued its power unabated, and with a roar that destroyed everything, it slammed into Jun Xiaoyao's chest that was blooming with dark golden light and engraved with domineering patterns!
“Pfft—!
! "
The indescribable impact sound was mixed with the clear sound of bone cracking!
Jun Xiaoyao's flawless face lost all color in an instant, and was filled with unprecedented horror, confusion and... disbelief!
title_en: Chapter 10: Blow away with one punch Chapter 11: Blast to death
